conceptual_change: Instead of static price level distance, I am using the delta of close_location to capture intra-bar price movement velocity. A positive delta suggests price is moving toward the high of the range after a consolidation or dip, identifying potential mean reversion to the upper bound of the recent range.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
